description: Call BEFORE an agent authorizes an autonomous payment. Evaluates it against your policy (max amount, allowed networks/assets, expected recipient, allowed origins) and returns a signed PREFLIGHT receipt -- ALLOW, REQUIRE_APPROVAL, or BLOCK, with reasons -- independently verifiable by anyone. Policy evaluation only: OCD never holds, moves, or authorizes funds. The wallet/x402 client separately authorizes execution after; ALLOW does not guarantee it will proceed.

amount.description: Canonical decimal string amount, e.g. "1.00". Never a float.

asset.description: Canonical ERC-20 token contract address (0x…) — never a ticker like "USDC".

kind.description: The only supported action kind in v1.

network.description: CAIP-2 network identifier, e.g. "eip155:8453" for Base mainnet.

resource.description: URL of the resource/service the payment is for, if any.

screen_recipient_sanctions.description: If true, exact-match the recipient (EVM addresses only) against OFAC SDN digital currency addresses; rejected before payment if current data is unavailable.

acknowledge_unconstrained.description: Required (true) if every constraint above is null/omitted, confirming that was intentional and not an accident.

allowed_assets.description: Allowed token contract addresses, or null for no restriction.

allowed_networks.description: Allowed CAIP-2 networks, or null for no restriction.

allowed_resource_origins.description: Allowed https origins for action.resource, or null.

expected_payer.description: Frozen commitment to the wallet expected to authorize the eventual on-chain payment (D2.4 binding strength) — decision-neutral, or null.

expected_recipient.description: Exact recipient address the caller expects, or null.

max_amount.description: Maximum allowed decimal amount, or null for no configured cap.

mandate_digest.description: Optional sha256:… digest of a private mandate this proposal was derived from.

name: preflight_payment
